{{Quote|Good guys wear white.|Various clone troopers|<ref name="GB:CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref>}}
'''Clone trooper armor''' included various types of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone forces]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was also worn by [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] following the [[Declaration of a New Order|creation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Eventually, the various types of clone trooper armor were replaced by [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]].
